entries.name: Realtek AmebaD SDK
entries.notes: [as of 2026-10-07] No CPE for the AmebaD/AmebaDplus SDK (ambd_sdk, ameba-rtos) and no RTL872x CPEs. CVE-2025-49604 (AmebaD WLAN defragment heap overflow in ameba-rtos-d/ameba-arduino-d) is Deferred with no configuration. The older Ameba1 SDK is a different SDK with its own product, a:amb1_sdk_project:amb1_sdk. It has 2 names ('-' and '2022-03-11') and 1 CVE: CVE-2022-29859 (DHCP server, versionEndExcluding 2022-03-11). Use it only for an amb1_sdk/Ameba1 component. Related chip-firmware CPEs: o:realtek:rtl8195am_firmware has 4 CVEs (CVE-2020-9395, CVE-2021-43573, CVE-2021-39306, CVE-2022-34326), and o:realtek:rtl8710c_firmware and o:realtek:rtl8195a_firmware carry CVE-2020-27301/27302 ('Ameba-based devices'). [NVD API 2.0, 2026-10-07; checked by two independent agents]

entries.name: STM32 Cryptographic Library
entries.notes: [as of 2026-10-07] No CPE of its own. CVE-2020-20949 (Bleichenbacher, X-CUBE-CRYPTOLIB v3 / UM1924) is configured on STM32Cube<family> package CPEs - check v3.x copies by hand. No product for the crypto library itself. Its one CVE (CVE-2020-20949, Bleichenbacher in X-CUBE-CRYPTOLIB) is configured on the per-family package CPEs a:st:stm32cubef0..wl, e.g. a:st:stm32cubel4, a:st:stm32cubeg0 and a:st:stm32cubeh7. [NVD API 2.0, 2026-10-07; checked by two independent agents]

entries.name: STM32CubeG0
entries.notes: [as of 2026-10-07] CVE-2020-20949 is configured only on version '-' (NA), check manually. Only version '-'. Its only CVE is CVE-2020-20949 (X-CUBE-CRYPTOLIB). [NVD API 2.0, 2026-10-07; checked by two independent agents]

entries.name: STM32CubeL4
entries.notes: [as of 2026-10-07] CVE-2020-20949 (on the alternate a:st:stm32cubel4) is configured only on version '-' (NA), check manually. part is 'o'. Versions are the plain package version without 'V': 1.14.0, 1.15.0, 1.15.1, 1.16.0, 1.17.0 and '-'. Newer packages (1.17.x+, 1.18.x) have no dictionary name, but the CVE criteria use version ranges. The CVEs CVE-2020-27212 (<=1.16.0) and CVE-2021-29414 (<=1.17.0) are STM32L4 read-out-protection issues, configured as this firmware running on h:st:stm32l4xx parts. The alternate a:st:stm32cubel4 has only version '-' and carries CVE-2020-20949 (X-CUBE-CRYPTOLIB), so query both. a:st:stm32cubel4\+ is the separate STM32CubeL4+ package. [NVD API 2.0, 2026-10-07; checked by two independent agents]

entries.name: STM32Cube MCU Packages
entries.notes: [as of 2026-10-07] The generic 'STM32Cube MCU & MPU Packages' CPE has versions '-' and 1.8.0 (ref STM32CubeH7 issue 76) and 0 CVEs. The alternate a:st:stm32cube_middleware is CVE-ONLY (no dictionary entry). It holds 6 USB-host CVEs (CVE-2021-34259/34260/34261/34262/34267/34268) with versionEndIncluding 1.8.0, where the version is the STM32Cube package version (STM32CubeH7). NVD also has one product per family: a:st:stm32cubef0, f1, f2, f3, f4, f7, g0, g4, h7, l0, l1, l4, l4\+, l5, mp1, wb and wl (version '-' only), plus o:st:stm32cubel4_firmware. There is no U5 or U3 product. [NVD API 2.0, 2026-10-07; checked by two independent agents]

entries.name: STM32 USB Host Library
entries.notes: [as of 2026-10-07] Six further CVEs (CVE-2021-34259..34268) sit on a:st:stm32cube_middleware with STM32Cube package versions <= 1.8.0. Dictionary versions are '-', 3.3.3, 3.3.4, 3.3.5, 3.4.0, 3.4.1 and 3.5.0. The CPE references github.com/STMicroelectronics/stm32_mw_usb_host. The alternate a:st:stm32cube_middleware is CVE-ONLY (no dictionary entry). It carries 6 USBH_* CVEs (CVE-2021-34259/34260/34261/34262/34267/34268) with versionEndIncluding 1.8.0. That number is the STM32Cube package version (from STM32CubeH7 GitHub issues 75-83), NOT the 3.x USB Host library version. Query it without a version (virtualMatchString=cpe:2.3:a:st:stm32cube_middleware) and judge applicability by hand. [NVD API 2.0, 2026-10-07; checked by two independent agents]

entries.name: wolfSSL
entries.notes: [as of 2026-10-07] Versions from 0.5 to 5.9.2 (e.g. 5.6.6, 5.9.2). Letter suffixes go in the version field (3.10.0a, 4.2.0c) and rc in the update field (4.0:rc1). CyaSSL (the pre-wolfSSL name) has a separate product, a:yassl:cyassl, with 6 names (2.5.0-2.9.4) and 4 CVEs (CVE-2012-1558, CVE-2013-1623, CVE-2014-2899, CVE-2014-2900); query it too for CyaSSL-era versions. a:wolfssl:wolfcrypt has one '-' CPE and 0 CVEs. a:wolfssl:yassl (the yaSSL C++ library), wolfboot, wolfmqtt, wolfprovider and wolfengine are separate products. [NVD API 2.0, 2026-10-07; checked by two independent agents]
